StageAttention: The Sixth Frostheart Emperor, Zack, heir to the royal lineage of Sophiasburgh, has launched a campaign into the Arctic territories to once again "amalgamate" the world under his rule.

Zack the Frostheart Emperor attacks in a set pattern, alternating between lasers and ice waves. In this phase, ice waves can be parried using timed attacks. In his Ultimate Amalgamation state, Zack will retaliate with a follow-up strike after his ice waves are parried.

Upon a distinct yellow double diamond indicator, Zack will cast ice waves or perform melee attacks. Jump at the right moment to avoid them, which allows you to counterattack Zack and interrupt his current skill.
Upon a distinct blue flash indicator, Zack will launch a single tracking attack. Dodge at the right moment to avoid it.
